rewritePack.summary: Rewrite the highest-leverage pages for trendingrepo.com to move from 51/100 toward 82/100. Prioritize Entity Clarity, Delegate-Economy Readiness, AI Discovery Endpoints, CSP Depth and keep the language citation-ready, answer-first, and machine-readable.
pageStrategy: Use homepage findings to prioritize the homepage plus the weakest 1 sampled internal pages.
Start every rewritten page with a direct category-and-differentiator opener before any CTA.
Add factual blocks, comparison logic, and visible FAQs where the audit found thin or weakly extractable content.
Mirror visible structure into schema and llms.txt references when the scanner flagged machine-readable gaps.
editorialContract: Lead with a plain-language answer block in the first 120 words.
Add at least one explicit 'not ideal when...' boundary for the main offer or recommendation.
Back every statistic, pricing claim, or superlative with an attributable source.
Prefer compact comparison tables, FAQ pairs, and section headings that can stand alone in retrieval.
implementationContract: Preserve canonical URLs and existing internal-link routes unless the audit explicitly identified URL problems.
Update title, description, Organization/Article/FAQ schema, and llms.txt references alongside copy rewrites.
Do not add hidden LLM instructions, invisible text, or decorative blocks that reduce extractability.
Ship changes as reviewable diffs per template: homepage, pricing/product, docs/article, support/about.
qualityGate: The rewritten page should improve the weakest scored dimensions without introducing new prompt-safety or negative-signal issues.
Visible content and schema must stay aligned.
Every rewritten page should contain one clear answer-first section, one evidence block, and one internal next-step link.
Re-scan after merge and compare against the previous domain history before marking the rewrite complete.
